title.narrative: Geoscope 20170508 - 20180331 Pungwe Monitoring Consultant Phase PPII Continued
Geoscope 20170508 - 20180331 Pungwe Monitoring konsult Fas PPII forstättning

description.narrative: Detta är en fortsättning av det tidigare konsultuppdraget till stöd för Pungwe-programmet. På grund av komplexiteten i utformningen av Pungweprogrammet har det ansetts finnas ett behov av att följa upp utvecklingen av programmet noga. När avtalet med parten förlängts är det också nödvändigt att skriva nytt kontrakt med monitoring konsulten. Enär ramavtal med WSP gått ut och det är denne specifike monitoring konsults kompetens Sida behöver skrivs det förnyade kontraktet med Geoscope AB där konsulten nu arbetar.
This is a continuation of the work of the monitoring consultant that has been assisting this project since 2015.

sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative: This consultancy was in reality a continuation of services provided by the same monitoring consultant in support of the Pungwe River Integrated Water Resources project (PP2). As the project was extended in time in 2017, there was also a need to extend the monitoring expert’s contract for the same period. Having the support of the monitoring consultant in the closing of the program has been important given the complexity of the program and the weak institutional capacity of the partner organizations (Ara Centro an Zinwasave). The continuity provided through the service has been important also as the program has moved between several different Sida program officers in the last period following the transfer of the project from the Embassy in Nairobi to the Embassy in Addis Ababa. The consultant has been able to assist Sida in the quality assurance of completion reports as well as of the baseline for evaluation prepared by Niras. The consultant has also prepared a concept note containing four priority strategic themes for continued transboundary water management in the three river basins of Buzi, Pungwe and Save (BUPUSA), reflecting an orientation that has been set out by Zimbabwe and Mozambique in the formulation of a new bridging project, the BUPUSA Tri-Basin Project, to be initiated in 2018. The note has been circulated to the relevant stakeholders in Mozambique and Zimbabwe.
